items.html: And the reason for the matter, why he had no share in the world of Assiyah, is in what we will explain of the order of the world and its division. For behold, the place of its ruin is the aspect opposite the Klipa. And the inhabited part of the world is divided into many divisions: the inhabited part outside the Land of Israel is opposite Assiyah; and all the Land of Israel is opposite Yetzirah. And this is what is said in Parashat Vayakhel, folio 209, col. 1: "The firmaments of Assiyah stand upon the land of Israel to protect it, etc." And the place of the Temple is opposite Beriah. And the place of the Holy of Holies is opposite the supernal hall of the Holy of Holies of Beriah.
